description: **`effects-bypass` no longer flags `platform.system()`.** The `system` leaf is now a finding only through the `os` receiver (`os.system`, `import os as o`, `from os import system`), so a pure in-process read no longer produces a finding whose remediation could not be followed. Receivers are also resolved through the module's imports, so `import requests as rq` + `rq.post(...)` and `from subprocess import run` + `run(...)` are now caught.
